$description: UBS Design System — Accessibility Tokens. WCAG 2.2 Level AA. Source: ubs.frontify.com

text.$description: Minimum contrast ratio for standard text against background.

largeText.$description: Minimum contrast ratio for text over 18pt (25 CSS px).

iconsAndGraphics.$description: Minimum contrast ratio for icons and graphic objects against background or adjacent colours.

chartSeparator.$description: Minimum separator/gap in charts if colour contrast below 3:1 between adjacent segments.

minimumFontSize.$description: 14 CSS px. Usually the minimum for accessibility.

recommendedLineHeight.$description: 22 CSS px. Line height for 12pt body text.

typography.pdfReflow: Content must work for enlargement up to 400%

charts.useLineTypes: Different line types for complex line charts and monochrome sequences

rules.noColourAlone: Colourblind users need additional design features beyond colour
